lines.text: A nerve ending releases a chemical messenger, acetylcholine, and the muscle fibre answers by pulling.
lines.phonemes: ɐ nˈɜːv ˈɛndɪŋ ɹɪlˈiːsɪz ɐ kˈɛmɪkəl mˈɛsɪndʒə, ˈasɪtˌɪlkəlˌiːn, and ðə mˈʌsəl fˈaɪbəɹ ˈansəz baɪ pˈʊlɪŋ.

lines.text: Botulinum toxin cuts one protein inside that nerve ending, so the message is never sent.
lines.phonemes: bˌɒtjʊlˈaɪnəm tˈɒksɪn kˈʌts wˈɒn pɹˈəʊtiːn ɪnsˈaɪd ðat nˈɜːv ˈɛndɪŋ, sˌəʊ ðə mˈɛsɪdʒ ɪz nˈɛvə sˈɛnt.

lines.text: The skin is never the target. The message is.
lines.phonemes: ðə skˈɪn ɪz nˈɛvə ðə tˈɑːɡɪt. ðə mˈɛsɪdʒ ɪz.
